- The changes in the dump logic ensure that the scheduler does not start dumping newer trees until all trees of the current `dump_generation` have been processed, addressing the bug introduced in a previous commit.

```c
scheduler->checkpoint_generation = 0;
scheduler->generation++;
```

The patch ensures that `scheduler->generation` is directly incremented during the checkpoint process, which reinstates the proper mechanism for rotating in-memory trees. This guarantees that only data of the same generation is included in snapshots, thus maintaining snapshot consistency.
